Orchestrator

# One prompt in.    A complete plan out.

The Orchestrator turns a single request into a multi-step plan and executes it

across Workday, SAP, ServiceNow, and 200+ other enterprise systems in your stack.

Book a demo

What it is

## The brain behind every workflow.

Every request — from chat, voice, email, Teams, Slack, MCP, A2A, or a scheduled trigger — lands in the Orchestrator first. It reads the intent, breaks the work into sub-tasks, and routes each one to the right AI Colleague.
It's model-agnostic on purpose. WorkLM™ (trained on real enterprise processes), GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5, Llama 4, or your own model — the Orchestrator stays in charge regardless of which one is reasoning underneath.

How it works

## From prompt to outcome  in five steps.

Every step is logged. You can trace any decision back to the prompt that triggered it.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/chatCircleDots_blue_solid.svg)

### Receives

A request comes in over chat, voice, email, Teams, Slack, MCP, A2A, or a schedule.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/sparkle_blue_overlay_hollow.svg)

### Reasons

Reads the intent. Pulls the right context, permissions, and prior decisions.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/listChecks_blue_solid.svg)

### Plans

Builds a fresh execution plan, grounded in your Agent Operating Protocols (AOPs).

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/treeStructure_blue_solid.svg)

### Delegates

Hands each sub-task to the right AI Colleague across your apps.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/rocketLaunch_blue_solid.svg)

### Acts

Calls real systems. Pauses for approvals. Resumes. Logs everything.

Why it matters

## Weeks of work, done in    one conversation.

End-to-end execution. Every step logged and auditable.

01 / Outcome

### Minutes, not weeks

"I'm moving to New York, get me set up." HR, IT, and Finance — provisioned, approved, and live in one flow. No follow-ups, no tickets, no "who owns this."

02 / Audit

### Every step traceable

Same rails, every run. Decisions, tool calls, and approvals are logged in plain language — so RCAs and compliance reviews stop being detective work.

03 / Ownership

### Owned by the business, not engineering

AOPs are written in plain English by the people closest to the process. Process changes go live without an engineering ticket.

What's different

## Deterministic where it counts.    Reasoning where it helps.

Most agents improvise their way through enterprise workflows — which is fine

for a demo and a problem in production. The Orchestrator does the opposite.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/sealCheck_green_overlay.svg)

### Deterministic by design

AOPs are the rails. The LLM reasons within them. No drift, no hallucinated tool calls, no surprise behavior on the hundredth run.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/sealCheck_green_overlay.svg)

### A fresh plan, every request

Plans are reasoned at runtime, not hard-coded. A new scenario doesn't need new code.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/sealCheck_green_overlay.svg)

### Stateful, end-to-end execution

Pauses for approvals. Resumes with full context — minutes, hours, or days later. The plan doesn't lose its place.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/sealCheck_green_overlay.svg)

### Model-agnostic

WorkLM™, GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5, Llama 4 — pick what fits each task. Swap them out as the frontier moves.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is an AI Orchestrator?

The engine that turns a single request into a multi-step workflow across your enterprise systems — and runs it end to end. It reads intent, builds a plan, delegates sub-tasks to specialized AI agents, and executes against real systems with approvals where needed.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### How is the Leena AI Orchestrator different from a chatbot or copilot?

Chatbots answer questions. Copilots suggest next steps. The Orchestrator finishes the work — calling Workday, SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and the rest of your stack, pausing for approvals, and logging every step.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### Which systems does the Orchestrator integrate with?

1,000+ pre-built tools across 200+ enterprise systems, including Workday, SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Oracle, UKG, Microsoft 365, and Google Workspace. In-house agents and custom tools plug in via MCP and A2A.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### How are long-running approvals handled?

Statefully. The Orchestrator pauses, waits for the approver, and resumes with full context — whether that's minutes, hours, or days later. The plan doesn't restart.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### Is the Orchestrator secure and compliant?

Yes. SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, and 27701. Trusted by

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### How are workflows defined?

In plain English, through Agent Operating Protocols (AOPs). The people closest to a process — HR ops, IT ops, finance ops — write and update the AOP. No engineering ticket required.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### Can the Orchestrator run without a chat prompt?

Yes. Workflows can be triggered by MCP and A2A calls, scheduled jobs, or system events. The chat prompt is one input among many.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### Which LLMs does the Orchestrator support?

WorkLM™ (Leena AI's enterprise-trained model), GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5, and Llama 4. The Orchestrator picks per task, or you can pin a model for a specific workflow.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### What happens when an LLM hallucinates inside a workflow?

The Orchestrator runs the LLM inside the AOP's guardrails. Tool calls outside the defined skill set are blocked, not improvised. If reasoning fails, the plan pauses for human review instead of guessing.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)
